major_cooldowns.name: Metamorphosis
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use on cooldown for massive damage and haste increases, ideally paired with Eye Beam and Essence Break.

major_cooldowns.name: Eye Beam
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use on cooldown to trigger the Demonic talent and enter short Metamorphosis windows.

major_cooldowns.name: Essence Break
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use immediately after Eye Beam finishes channeling to amplify Chaos Strike and Blade Dance.

major_cooldowns.name: The Hunt
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use on cooldown, ideally during a Metamorphosis window or as an opener.

defensives.name: Blur
defensives.usage_rule: Use proactively on a short cooldown to dodge physical attacks and reduce damage by 20%.

defensives.name: Netherwalk
defensives.usage_rule: Use to immune all damage, often used to soak lethal mechanics.

rules.action: Always cast Essence Break immediately after Eye Beam. Dump all Fury on Chaos Strike or Blade Dance within the 4-second debuff window.
Cast Metamorphosis immediately after an Eye Beam + Essence Break combo finishes to reset Eye Beam and Blade Dance.
Use Chaos Strike or Blade Dance to prevent Fury from reaching its maximum.

source_summary: Havoc Demon Hunter revolves around the 'Demonic' window. The spec builds up to a highly concentrated burst sequence consisting of Eye Beam followed instantly by Essence Break, dumping resources into the short vulnerability window.
